station_name: Sly Creek Reservoir near Strawberry Valley, Calif.
township_range_section: NW¼NW¼ sec.20, T.20 N., R.8 E.
notes: Daily contents at 1600, water year October 1969 to September 1970: every day filled, 365 values (Feb has 28). Row (a) gives elevation at end of month (12 values); I counted these as measurements of a second variable (365+12=377). If row (a) is treated as a summary row, n_measurements is 365 and variables is contents only. Other numbers: MAX 12, MIN 12, (b) change in contents 12, CAL YR and WAT YR lines 3+3 = 42, total 419. Location paragraph also: Plumas National Forest, on right bank 100 ft upstream from dam on Lost Creek, 1.4 miles northwest of Strawberry Valley.
